Music streaming: daily challenge, 2027-01-19

The shared System Designer challenge for 2027-01-19: Music streaming. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

People search for songs, build playlists and press play. The audio is the heavy part, and a hit song is played by millions at once. Playback must not stutter, even when part of your system fails.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
